gloss: 110; the police emergency number in Japan

definitions.gloss: 110; Japan's police emergency number; a call to the police
definitions.explanation: The three-digit number dialled to reach the police in an emergency. Also used with する to mean 'to call the police.' Normally written 110{番|ばん} in figures.

examples.japanese: ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{百十番|ひゃくとおばん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please call the police right away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧{百十番|ひゃくとおばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通報|つうほう}→通報：14318_tsuuhou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I saw the accident and reported it to the police.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧でない⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{百十番|ひゃくとおばん}⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{警察相談|けいさつそうだん}⟦ダイヤル→ダイヤル：28313_daiyaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: For non-emergency matters you call the police consultation line rather than 110.

notes:
Written 110⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧ in ordinary text; the kanji spelling {百十番|ひゃくとおばん} appears mainly when the reading has to be shown. Note that ⟦{十|とお}→十：28376_too⟧ is read とお here, not じゅう.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {百十番|ひゃくとおばん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to call the police
- {百十番|ひゃくとおばん}⟦{通報|つうほう}→通報：14318_tsuuhou⟧: a 110 call, an emergency report to police
- {百十番|ひゃくとおばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to dial 110

OTHER EMERGENCY NUMBERS:
- 119⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧: fire and ambulance
- 118⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧: coast guard (maritime emergencies)
